name: Project: Newtime 2
desc:
Project: Newtime is a derivative of the original game Poppy Playtime Escape From Playtime on Steam.

🕹️:
- Solve the puzzle pillars
- Assemble the toy parts
- Escape through the train
- Monster prevents survivors from escaping
- Earn rewards playing, complete missions

✨The game will be updated soon (there's only one person working on updates).
